description: Use this when the author asks to open an existing post card, requests another card or reports a missing card. Do not call automatically after create_post_draft: it already attaches a card, so another call duplicates it. Find postId with search_posts/search_post_drafts. Renders preview and publication controls in MCP Apps hosts; a browser preview link is different. Never publishes, schedules or enables a public link.
name: show_post_card
title: Show a Postlyra post in chat
